mapper.insert: INSERT INTO note_daily_stats (note_id, stat_date, like_count) VALUES (#{noteId}, #{statDate}, GREATEST(#{delta}, 0)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE like_count = GREATEST(like_count + #{delta}, 0)
INSERT INTO note_daily_stats (note_id, stat_date, comment_count) VALUES (#{noteId}, #{statDate}, GREATEST(#{delta}, 0)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE comment_count = GREATEST(comment_count + #{delta}, 0)
INSERT INTO note_daily_stats (note_id, stat_date, collect_count) VALUES (#{noteId}, #{statDate}, GREATEST(#{delta}, 0)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE collect_count = GREATEST(collect_count + #{delta}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT note_id, stat_date, like_count, comment_count, collect_count, updated_at FROM note_daily_stats WHERE note_id = #{noteId} AND stat_date >= #{since} ORDER BY stat_date
